:::{#exm-collection}
#### The collection of all subsets of a two-element set

The subsets of $\set{1, 2}$ are $\emptyset$, $\set{1}$, $\set{2}$, and $\set{1, 2}$
(@thm-empty-subset and @thm-subset-reflexive give the first and the last),
so the collection of all subsets of $\set{1, 2}$ is

$$\set{\emptyset, \set{1}, \set{2}, \set{1, 2}}$$

It has four elements, each of them a set.
The collection $\set{\emptyset}$ has one element, the empty set,
so it is not equal to $\emptyset$, which has none.

:::
